naruto1.name: Uzumaki Barrage
naruto1.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy. Deals 5 additional damage for every stack of Shadow Clones.

naruto2.name: Rasengan
naruto2.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy for 2 turns and Shatters for 1 turn. On the second turn, the target is fully stunned. This deals 5 additional damage for every stack of Shadow Clones.

naruto3.name: Shadow Clones
naruto3.description: Naruto permanently gains 50% Damage Reduction and his skills are improved. One stack of this effect is lost each time Naruto takes new damage.

naruto4.name: Summoning: Gamabunta
naruto4.description: The next time Naruto's health is brought to 45 or below, this skill will activate. When triggered, all enemy skills are removed from him, he becomes invulnerable for 1 turn, Uzumaki Barrage and this skill swap to their alternate abilities, and Rasengan will deal its damage and non-damage effects instantly. This skill cannot be removed.

naruto5.name: Naruto 2K Barrage
naruto5.description: Naruto deals 40 damage to one enemy and grants himself 2 stacks of Shadow Clones.

naruto6.name: Kyuubi Healing
naruto6.description: Naruto heals 5 health every turn for the rest of the game. Stacks up to 4 times.

sasuke1.name: Sharingan Windmill Triple Attack
sasuke1.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy, Shatters them, and marks them for 1 turn. If the target does not use a new skill while marked, they have this skill re-applied to them. This becomes 'Fire Release: Dragon Fire Technique' until the mark ends. Uncounterable.

sasuke2.name: Phoenix Flower Shuriken
sasuke2.description: Deals 5 physical and 5 affliction* damage to one enemy and marks them for 1 turn. If they use a new skill while marked, this is re-applied to them. This does not stack and will re-apply itself.

sasuke3.name: Curse Mark Release
sasuke3.description: For 3 turns, Sasuke Uchiha gains 10 points of damage reduction, 'Phoenix Flower Shuriken' will target all enemies. This swaps to 'Brutality' while active.

sasuke4.name: Sasuke Reflexes
sasuke4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

sasuke5.name: Fire Release: Dragon Fire Technique
sasuke5.description: Deals 30 affliction damage to one enemy. If the target is marked by 'Sharingan Windmill Triple Attack' they will be dealt 15 affliction damage permanently (stacks).

sasuke6.name: Corrupt Chidori
sasuke6.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy. If the target is marked by 'Sharingan Windmill Triple Attack' or 'Phoenix Flower Shuriken' then they are executed if their health falls to 10HP or below.

sakura1.name: Sakura Clone Jutsu
sakura1.description: Sakura targets an enemy for 1 turn, counters them if they use a new harmful skill, and gains 1 random energy if successful. Swaps to 'Kunai Stabbing' for 1 turn.

sakura2.name: Inner Sakura
sakura2.description: Sakura gains 15 points of Damage Reduction and ignores enemy stun effects for 3 turns. While this is active, this swaps to 'Mind Strangle'.

sakura3.name: Log Fall Trap
sakura3.description: Sakura permanently marks herself or an ally. The first enemy to use a new harmful skill on them will receive 25 damage and be stunned for 1 turn. Invisible until triggered, and swaps to Kunai Stabbing for 1 turn on use.

sakura4.name: Sakura Substitution
sakura4.description: Sakura becomes invulnerable for 1 turn and swaps this skill to Kunai Stabbing for 1 turn.

sakura5.name: Mind Strangle
sakura5.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy and stuns their physical, mental, and strategic skills for 1 turn.

hinata1.name: Gentle Fist Taijutsu
hinata1.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy for 4 turns. During this time, this skill can be used again to deal 5 Piercing damage to the originally targeted enemy.

hinata2.name: Protective Eight Trigrams: 64 Palms
hinata2.description: For 4 turns, Hinata's team gains 5 Damage Reduction. During this time, Hinata will deal 5 Piercing damage to any enemy that uses a new Harmful skill on her team, and this skill can be used for no cost to give an ally 10 Shield.

hinata3.name: Eight Trigrams: Air Palm
hinata3.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and stuns their Harmful skills for 1 turn. This skill costs 1 less Random energy if Hinata is using Gentle Fist Taijutsu, and 1 less Random energy if she is using Protective Eight Trigrams: 64 Palms.

hinata4.name: My Turn To Protect
hinata4.description: Hinata applies a permanent, invisible mark to another ally. If an enemy stuns that ally or lowers their HP below 30, Hinata will permanently taunt that enemy. Afterward, this skill will be permanently replaced by Gentle Step: Twin Lions Fist.

hinata5.name: Gentle Step: Twin Lions Fist
hinata5.description: For the next 4 turns, Hinata will deal 10 damage to any enemy she damages (other than with this effect). During this time, Hinata can use this skill to deal 15 damage to an enemy twice.

hashirama1.name: Deep Forest Bloom: Pollen
hashirama1.description: Hashirama heals his team for 10 HP and deals 10 Affliction damage to the enemy team. This skill is delayed by 1 turn. While enhanced, this skill will heal Hashirama's team for 5 HP and deal 5 Affliction damage to the enemy team each turn that it remains delayed.

hashirama2.name: Deep Forest Bloom: Strangle
hashirama2.description: Target enemy takes 10 damage and is stunned for 1 turn. This skill is always delayed by 1 turn. While enhanced, this skill will stun a random targetable enemy's Physical and Energy skills each turn that it remains delayed.

hashirama3.name: Deep Forest Creation
hashirama3.description: For the next 3 turns, Deep Forest Bloom: Pollen and Deep Forest Bloom: Strangle are enhanced and delayed for 1 more turn. While active, this skill can be reactivated to extend the duration on all active delay effects by 1 turn.

hashirama4.name: Wood Clone
hashirama4.description: For one turn, the first Harmful skill that targets Hashirama or one ally will be delayed for 2 turns. Invisible until triggered.

hashirama5.name: Great Thriving Forest
hashirama5.description: Passive: At the end of each of his turns, Hashirama will give his team 5 Shield and deal 5 Piercing damage to the enemy team for each of Hashirama's currently delayed skills.

luffy1.name: Gomu Gomu No Pistol
luffy1.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy, Bypassing Invulnerability. This skill deals 10 additional damage and refunds Luffy 1 red energy if used on an enemy who is Invulnerable.

luffy2.name: Gomu Gomu No Gatling Gun
luffy2.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies, Bypassing Invulnerability. This skill deals 5 more damage every time it is used (stacks) and lasts 1 more turn if used on an enemy who is Invulnerable.

luffy3.name: Gomu Gomu No Bazooka
luffy3.description: Deals 40 damage to one enemy, Bypassing Invulnerability. This skill fully stuns the target for 1 turn if used on an enemy who is Invulnerable.

luffy4.name: Gomu Gomu No Balloon
luffy4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

luffy5.name: Rubber Body
luffy5.description: Passive: Whenever Luffy deals damage to an enemy, he will gain an equal amount of Shield for 1 turn.

zoro1.name: Onigiri
zoro1.description: Deals 35 damage to one enemy and grants Zoro 10 Shield for 1 turn. Swaps to 'Crab Grab'.

zoro2.name: Master of Swords
zoro2.description: For 1 turn, Zoro will ignore enemy stun effects and his skills will deal 5 additional damage permanently (stacks).

zoro3.name: Three-Sword Style Counter
zoro3.description: Zoro will counter the first enemy skill used on himself and one ally for 1 turn. Invisible.

zoro4.name: Three-Sword Style Parry
zoro4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

zoro5.name: One-Sword Style: Lion Strike
zoro5.description: Deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy and grants Zoro 10 Shield for 1 turn. If the target drops to 15HP or below they will be executed. Bypasses invulnerability. Swaps to 'Onigiri'.

usopp1.name: Smoke Star
usopp1.description: Usopp Blinds target enemy for 3 turns, and a different random enemy for 1 turn. Will not randomly target an enemy already affected by Smoke Star. Bypassing.

usopp2.name: Impact Dial
usopp2.description: For 1 turn, if any enemy uses a new skill on Usopp or target ally, they will be countered and Stunned for 1 turn if they are currently Blinded.

usopp3.name: Lead Star
usopp3.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy, then deals 10 damage to all Blinded enemies.

usopp4.name: Gunpowder Star
usopp4.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies. Enemies currently affected by Smoke Star take 5 more damage for each turn left on its duration. This ends Smoke Star on all affected targets, and any damaged enemy will have Smoke Star permanently last one more turn against them.

usopp5.name: Sharpshooter
usopp5.description: Passive: Usopp's attacks cannot Miss or be Dodged, and he ignores Blind effects.

ace1.name: Fire Fist
ace1.description: Deals 10 damage and 0 Affliction damage to target enemy.

ace2.name: Firefly
ace2.description: Ace applies 1 stack of Firefly to all enemies. Whenever deals new damage to a marked enemy, Ace will consume those marks to deal 10 damage for each mark consumed.

ace3.name: Flame Emperor
ace3.description: Deals 40 damage to target enemy, and 0 permanent Affliction damage to all enemies. This permanent damage can stack.

ace4.name: Flame Pillar
ace4.description: Ace gains 50% Damage Reduction for 1 turn, and 5 Damage Reduction permanently (stacks).

ace5.name: Flame Commandment
ace5.description: Passive: Flat Damage Reduction on Ace increases his new Affliction damage by the same amount.

rob9.name: Neko Neko no Mi, Model: Leopard

yuji1.name: Divergent Fist
yuji1.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy. The following turn, that enemy takes 5 True damage.

yuji2.name: Combat Awakening
yuji2.description: Divergent Fist will target two enemies at random the next time it is used (the same enemy can be chosen twice). If Yuji is below 50 HP, Divergent Fist also deals True damage instead of normal damage on its initial hit. Using this skill increases Yuji's chance to trigger Black Flash by 15%.

yuji3.name: Consume Finger
yuji3.description: Yuji heals himself for 15 HP and permanently increases the minimum chance for Black Flash to activate by 10%.

yuji4.name: Unusual Fortitude
yuji4.description: Itadori Yuji becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

yuji5.name: Black Flash
yuji5.description: Passive: Whenever Yuji deals True damage, he has a 5% chance to deal 15 bonus True damage and stun his target's Harmful skills for 1 turn. This chance increases by 5% each time he deals True damage, and resets to 5% when it triggers successfully.

nobara1.name: Hammer Swing
nobara1.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and permanently increases the damage they take from this skill by 5 (stacks).

nobara2.name: Straw Doll Technique
nobara2.description: Until Nobara dies or this skill is re-used, one enemy is permanently Isolated and receives 10 less healing from all sources. Additionally, Resonance's stuns last 3 turns on an enemy affected by this skill.

nobara3.name: Resonance
nobara3.description: For the next 4 turns, Hammer Swing will stun its target's Physical skills for 1 turn. Each turn, the class of skill stunned will rotate in the following order: Energy, Affliction, Mental. Swaps to Embrace Pain while active.

nobara5.name: Hairpin
nobara5.description: Nobara counters the first Harmful skill used by target enemy. Countered enemies are executed if their HP is 30 or less. If the target is affected by Straw Doll Technique, this skill lasts for 2 turns and deals 20 damage instead of executing. Invisible until triggered.

nobara4.name: Embrace Pain
nobara4.description: For 2 turns, Nobara will ignore instant-kill and execute effects. At the end of each of her turns, if she is affected by a harmful non-damaging effect, she will heal 15 HP and gain 10 DR until this skill ends. Usable while stunned.

sukuna1.name: Malevolent Shrine
sukuna1.description: Sukuna targets all other characters for 4 turns, executing them if their HP falls to 5 or less. This threshold increases by 5 each turn, and whenever a selected character uses a skill on Sukuna. During this time, Cleave and Dismantle damages random enemies 2 additional times.

sukuna2.name: Fire Arrow
sukuna2.description: Sukuna targets an enemy. If their HP is 100-61, he sets their HP to 60. If their HP is 60-31, he sets their HP to 30. If their HP is 30 or less, he executes them.

sukuna3.name: Cleave and Dismantle
sukuna3.description: Sukuna deals 5 damage to all characters. This effect deals damage to an additional random enemy each time Sealed King has been activated this game.

sukuna4.name: Demonic Pact
sukuna4.description: Sukuna deals 10 Affliction damage to the ally marked by Sealed King. For 1 turn, that enemy receives triple effect from Sealed King's damage boost, and they ignore non-damage effects. Only usable while Sukuna is stunned by Sealed King and the marked ally is stunned by a different effect.

sukuna5.name: Sealed King
sukuna5.description: Passive: Sukuna is permanently stunned, untargetable, and he permanently marks a random ally at the beginning of the game, increasing their non-Affliction damage by 5. Each game, the first time the marked ally's HP falls below 70/30, Sukuna will disable Sealed King on himself and apply it to his ally for 3 turns. If the marked ally dies, Sukuna permanently disables Sealed King.

midoriya1.name: Blackwhip
midoriya1.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy and stuns their helpful skills for 1 turn. The following turn, Midoriya will deal 10 additional damage to them.

midoriya2.name: St. Louis Smash
midoriya2.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy and fully stuns them for 1 turn. Swaps to 'Faux 100%' for 1 turn.

midoriya3.name: Detroit Smash
midoriya3.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy and fully silences their skills for 1 turn.

midoriya4.name: One For All
midoriya4.description: Midoriya gains 5 points of damage reduction, increases his damage by 5, and ignores enemy stun effects for the rest of the game. This skill stacks. Midoriya loses 5HP every time he uses a new skill (stacks).

midoriya5.name: Faux 100%
midoriya5.description: Deals 45 Piercing damage to one enemy. For the rest of the game, Midoriya's skills will make him Invulnerable for 1 turn and Bypass Invulnerability.

uraraka2.name: Gravity Plus
uraraka2.description: Every enemy marked by 'Zero Gravity' takes 20 damage and has the cost of their skills increased by 1 random energy until they use a new skill (stacks).

uraraka1.name: Zero Gravity
uraraka1.description: Marks one enemy. The next skill they use will have its damage reduced by 10 and will remove 1 random energy from them. Swaps to 'Gravity Plus' for 1 turn. Stackable. Invisible.

uraraka3.name: Zero Gravity: Comet Shower
uraraka3.description: Grants all enemies a stack of 'Zero Gravity'. Swaps to 'Gravity Plus' for 2 turns.

uraraka4.name: Uraraka Float
uraraka4.description: For 2 turns, Uraraka gains 20 points of Shield and any enemy that uses a new skill on her will have 'Zero Gravity' used on them. During this time, this skill is replaced by 'Gravity Plus'. Invisible.

bakugo1.name: Detonating Touch
bakugo1.description: Deals 10 energy damage and 10 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, if this target uses a new non-strategic skill, they will take 10 affliction damage.

bakugo2.name: AP Shot
bakugo2.description: Deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy ignoring invulnerability. For 2 turns this enemy is Shattered and ignores Shield effects.

bakugo3.name: Stun Grenade
bakugo3.description: Stuns all enemies' Strategic skills for 1 turn. For 1 turn this swaps to Hauser Impact.

bakugo4.name: Explosive Dash
bakugo4.description: This skill makes Katsuki Bakugou invulnerable for 1 turn.

bakugo5.name: Hauser Impact
bakugo5.description: Deals 20 damage, 15 piercing damage, and 10 affliction damage to one enemy. All stacks of Nitroglycerin Storage will be reset.

bakugo6.name: Nitroglycerin Storage
bakugo6.description: Passive: This skill triggers each time Bakugou uses a new non-Strategic skill. He gains 5 additional damage permanently.

toga1.name: Thirsting Knife
toga1.description: Toga deals 15 piercing damage to target enemy and gains one stack of Twisted Love.

toga2.name: Vacuum Syringe
toga2.description: Toga deals 10 Affliction damage to one enemy for three turns, gaining one stack of Twisted Love each turn.

toga3.name: Killing Spree
toga3.description: Toga deals 30 Piercing damage to one enemy and becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn.

toga4.name: Twisted Love
toga4.description: For the next 4 turns, if Toga has 2 or more Twisted Love stacks, Killing Spree deals 15 more damage. If she has 4 or more Twisted Love stacks, her skills cost 1 less Random energy. If she has 6 or more, Twisted Love is replaced by Drop Dead for the duration.

toga5.name: Quirk: Transform
toga5.description: Passive: Toga starts the game disguised as another character (showing their face picture). This effect will end if she takes damage or uses a skill other than Thirsting Knife.

toga6.name: Drop Dead
toga6.description: Toga stuns all enemies for 1 turn. On the following turn, they take 25 damage.

natsu1.name: Fire Dragon's Iron Fist
natsu1.description: Deals 15 physical damage and 5 affliction damage to one enemy.

natsu2.name: Fire Dragon's Wing Attack
natsu2.description: Natsu deals 20 physical damage to one enemy and for one turn if they use a new skill, it is delayed for 2 turns. If they do not, Natsu deals 15 physical damage and 5 affliction damage to the enemy team.

natsu4.name: Consume Flame
natsu4.description: Natsu removes all enemy effects from himself and heals himself 15HP. For each effect removed, Natsu heals 10 more HP and gains 1 stack of I'm all fired up!. This skill swaps to Fire Dragon's Roar for 1 turn for each harmful effect removed.

natsu5.name: I'm all fired up!
natsu5.description: Whenever Natsu is targeted by a new harmful Strategic skill or deals new Affliction damage, he deals 5 more Affliction damage with all his skills for 3 turns. This effect stacks.

natsu3.name: Fire Dragon's Roar
natsu3.description: Deals 35 affliction damage to an enemy and reduces their non-Affliction damage by 15 for 1 turn. For 1 turn, this skill will deal 15 affliction damage and cost a single random, but it can only be used on the previous target of this skill.

lucy1.name: Aquarius
lucy1.description: Lucy deals 15 damage to all enemies and grants her team 10 points of damage reduction for one turn.

lucy2.name: Gemini
lucy2.description: For the next three turns, Lucy's skills will stay active for one more turn. During this time, this ability is replaced by Urano Metria.

lucy3.name: Capricorn
lucy3.description: Lucy deals 25 damage to one enemy.

lucy4.name: Leo
lucy4.description: Lucy becomes invulnerable for one turn.

lucy5.name: Urano Metria
lucy5.description: Lucy deals 25 damage to all enemies.

gray1.name: Ice, Make...
gray1.description: Until the end of his next turn, Gray ignores stun effects and can use his skills. During this time, this skill is replaced by Ice, Make Unlimited. If Ice, Make Unlimited is already active, this skill is replaced by One-Sided Chaotic Dance.

gray2.name: Ice, Make Freeze Lancer
gray2.description: Gray deals 15 piercing damage to the enemy team for 2 turns.

gray3.name: Ice, Make Hammer
gray3.description: Deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns them for 1 turn.

gray4.name: Ice, Make Shield
gray4.description: Gray becomes invulnerable for one turn.

gray5.name: Disciple of Ur
gray5.description: The first time Gray's health reaches 30 or below, he will permanently gain the effects of Ice, Make... and Ice, Make Shield will be replaced by Iced Shell.

gray6.name: Ice, Make Unlimited
gray6.description: For the rest of the game, Gray's team gains 5 Shield each turn, and the enemy team receives 5 piercing damage each turn.

gray7.name: Iced Shell
gray7.description: Target enemy is permanently stunned and will take 10 true damage each turn. After applying this effect, Gray dies. This skill cannot be countered or reflected, and this death cannot be prevented with effects.

gray8.name: One-Sided Chaotic Dance
gray8.description: Deals 5 piercing damage to one enemy, increased by 10 for each time Ice, Make... has been used during the battle.

madoka1.name: Magical Arrow
madoka1.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. This skill deals 5 additional damage for each Shield or Nullify effect on Madoka and her target.

madoka2.name: Rose Barrage
madoka2.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage to the enemy team for 4 turns. While active, can be used for no cost to deal 5 Piercing damage and apply 15 points of Nullify to a single enemy until Rose Barrage ends.

madoka3.name: Karmic Destiny
madoka3.description: For 3 turns, whenever a character uses a new skill, they will permanently gain 5 Shield if they're an ally or 5 Nullify if they're an enemy.

madoka4.name: My Wish
madoka4.description: Madoka targets an ally. If that ally is dead, they are resurrected with 50 HP. If that ally is alive, they have all enemy effects removed from them, heal to full health, and become invulnerable for one turn. If that ally is Madoka, all enemies are permanently silenced and Madoka dies. This skill can only be used if Madoka has at least 7 stacks of her passive.

madoka5.name: Soul Gem: Madoka
madoka5.description: Passive: Whenever one of Madoka's Shield or Nullify effects is fully absorbed, this effect gains one stack. If Madoka reaches 15 stacks of this effect, she is instantly killed.

sayaka1.name: Hero Slash
sayaka1.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy and heals Sayaka for 10 HP. This skill will deal 5 additional damage for each 20HP healed by Sayaka's abilities.

sayaka2.name: Azure Healing
sayaka2.description: Sayaka heals an ally for 10 health for 5 turns.

sayaka3.name: Hero Counter
sayaka3.description: For one turn, if target enemy uses a new damaging ability, it will heal instead of dealing damage. Invisible.

sayaka4.name: Azure Deflection
sayaka4.description: Sayaka targets herself or an ally for one turn. The first harmful skill used on them will be countered. If this effect is not triggered, Sayaka heals 15 health.

sayaka5.name: Berserk
sayaka5.description: Once Sayaka has received 80 damage, her Strategic skills are permanently stunned and Hero Slash is replaced by Enraged Slash.

sayaka6.name: Enraged Slash
sayaka6.description: Deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill cannot deal less than 20 damage. Uncounterable, Bypassing. Grants Sayaka one stack of Soul Gem: Sayaka.

sayaka7.name: Soul Gem: Sayaka
sayaka7.description: Passive: Sayaka gains 1 stack of this skill each turn. While Sayaka has at least 6 stacks, she heals 5 health per turn per 20 health she is missing. Sayaka ignores effects that prevent her healing. If Sayaka reaches 12 stacks of this effect, she instantly dies.

mami1.name: Tiro Concert
mami1.description: Mami permanently marks the enemy team. Whenever a marked enemy uses a skill, they will take 5 damage (stacks).

mami2.name: Ribbon Wrap
mami2.description: Mami isolates target enemy for 1 turn and stuns their Harmful skills. If Mami Soul Gem has at least 3 stacks, this skill swaps to Tiro Finale for 1 turn.

mami3.name: Tiro Assault
mami3.description: Mami targets one enemy for 3 turns. During this time, that enemy will take 5 damage per turn and Mami will counter the first Harmful skill used on each turn. Each time this effect counters a skill, the enemy gains a stack of Tiro Concert and Mami gains a stack of Mami Soul Gem.

mami4.name: Ribbon Show
mami4.description: Mami removes all harmful effects from her team.

mami5.name: Tiro Finale
mami5.description: Mami deals 40 damage to the enemy affected by Ribbon Wrap, increased by 10 for each stack of Tiro Concert on the enemy. Afterwards, all stacks of Tiro Concert are removed from them.

mami6.name: Soul Gem: Mami
mami6.description: Passive: Mami permanently ignores stun effects and gains 1 stack of this effect each turn. While she has at least 3 stacks, Tiro Finale can be used. While she has at least 4 stacks, Tiro Concert deals 5 more damage and she gains 1 more stack each turn. When Mami has 6 stacks of this effect, she instantly dies.

asta1.name: Demon-Slayer Sword
asta1.description: Asta equips the Demon-Slayer Sword. While equipped, he deals 5 additional damage and enemies damaged by him are permanently marked. If Asta damages a marked enemy while wielding a different sword, he will consume the mark to taunt that enemy for 1 turn. Asta can only have one sword equipped at a time.

asta2.name: Demon-Dweller Sword
asta2.description: Asta equips the Demon-Dweller Sword. While equipped, he heals 10 health whenever Liebe Unite deals damage. If he is at full health when this occurs, he will gain 10 permanent Shield instead (this effect does not stack). Asta can only have one sword equipped at a time.

asta3.name: Demon-Destroyer Sword
asta3.description: Asta equips the Demon-Destroyer Sword. While equipped, he deals 10 additional damage, and takes 10 affliction damage whenever Liebe Unite deals damage. Asta can only have one sword equipped at a time.

asta4.name: Liebe Unite
asta4.description: For the rest of the game, Asta will randomly attack one enemy at the end of the turn, dealing 15 damage and applying any weapon effects from his equipped sword. The first time he falls below 70 health, he will counterattack the first person to target him with a skill every turn, dealing 10 damage. The first time he falls below 40 health, he may equip two swords at once.

yuno1.name: Wind Blades Shower
yuno1.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to all enemies. If this ability hits all living enemies, Spirit Dive: Sylph has its cost reduced by 1 blue energy until its next use.

yuno2.name: Towering Tornado
yuno2.description: For 2 turns, one enemy will be Shattered and if they use a new harmful skill, they take 5 piercing damage. While this is active, Spirit Dive: Sylph has its cost reduced by 1 blue energy.

yuno3.name: Spirit Dive: Sylph
yuno3.description: For 3 turns, Yuno gains 1 blue energy per turn and gains 10 damage reduction. Replaces Wind Blades Shower with Gale White Bow, Towering Torando with Sylph's Breath, and this skill with Spirit of Zephyr while active.

yuno4.name: Sylph Block
yuno4.description: Yuno becomes invulnerable for one turn.

yuno5.name: Gale White Bow
yuno5.description: Deals 35 piercing damage to all enemies. For each enemy struck, Spirit of Zephyr has its cost reduced by 1 blue energy until its next use.

yuno6.name: Sylph's Breath
yuno6.description: For 2 turns, all enemies will be Shattered and take 10 piercing damage per turn. While this is active, Spirit of Zephyr has its cost reduced by 2 blue energy

yuno7.name: Spirit of Zephyr
yuno7.description: Deals 65 piercing damage to one enemy, Bypassing Invulnerability. If this ability is countered, it will automatically cast itself on the following turn. If this ability kills the target, Spirit Dive: Sylph has its duration increased by 2 turns.

noelle1.name: Sea Dragon's Roar
noelle1.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. This skill will consume Sea Dragon's Cradle on an affected target to stun its target for 1 turn.

noelle2.name: Sea Dragon's Cradle
noelle2.description: Noelle targets all enemies for 2 turns, increasing the costs of their skills by one random. This effect is removed on the next skill used by each affected target.

noelle3.name: Saint Valkyrie Dress
noelle3.description: Noelle gains 10 damage reduction for 3 turns. During this time, Sea Dragon's Cradle will last two additional turns and no longer be consumed by Sea Dragon's Roar. If used while Sea Dragon's Cradle is active, extends its duration by two turns. Swaps to Point-Blank Sea Dragon's Roar.

noelle5.name: Point-Blank Sea Dragon's Roar
noelle5.description: Deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill will consume Sea Dragon's Cradle on an affected target to deal 15 more damage.

maka1.name: Reap
maka1.description: Maka deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy.

maka2.name: Soul Resonance
maka2.description: For 3 turns, Maka and target ally ignore harmful non-damage effects and their skills have 1 less cooldown.

maka3.name: Witch Hunter
maka3.description: One enemy permanently takes 10 piercing damage per turn. During this time, their skills cost one more random energy, Reap is replaced by Figure-6 Hunter, and if the targeted enemy uses a new harmful skill, this effect will end. Channeled.

maka4.name: Scythe Deflection
maka4.description: For 1 turn, Maka will counter all Physical skills that targets her. If she is wielding Soul, this skill has a 2 turn cooldown. This effect is invisible.

maka5.name: Figure-6 Hunter
maka5.description: Maka deals 35 true damage to the enemy affected by Witch Hunter. This skill gains double effect from allied damage increases.

maka6.name: Partner: Soul
maka6.description: Passive: If Soul Evans is on Maka's team, Soul Resonance always costs nothing, cannot be stunned, and can only target him.

soul1.name: Scythe Transformation
soul1.description: For 3 turns, target ally wields Soul. During this time, Soul gains 10 Damage Reduction, and the targeted ally deals 5 more non-Affliction damage and has their Red costs changed to Random costs.

soul2.name: Nightmare Wavelength
soul2.description: Deals 30 affliction damage to one enemy and Soul. If an ally is wielding Soul, the damage is split between them.

soul3.name: Nightmare Sonata
soul3.description: For 3 turns, enemies have their strategic skills delayed for 1 turn and Nightmare Wavelength deals 20 more damage.

soul4.name: Consume Soul
soul4.description: Soul heals 50 health and permanently increases the bonus damage effect from Scythe Transformation by 5. Soul must deal 100 damage before each use of this skill.

soul5.name: Partner: Maka
soul5.description: Passive: If Maka is alive on Soul's team, Scythe Transformation can only target her and he will begin the game with Maka wielding him.

soul_cleave.name: Soul Cleave
soul_cleave.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies. While enhanced, heals the Black Knight for 10 health.

blackstar1.name: Speed Star
blackstar1.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to one target. The following turn, this skill may be used again for 1 random, dealing the same damage and making Black Star invulnerable for 1 turn. While enhanced, this skill has a 2 turn cooldown.

blackstar2.name: Black Star Big Wave
blackstar2.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to one target and stuns them for 1 turn. If Black Star is affected by Speed Star, this ability is Uncounterable.

blackstar3.name: Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode
blackstar3.description: For 3 turns, Black Star gains 5 Damage Reduction and Taunts target enemy. This effect Bypasses, and swaps Speed Star and Black Star Big Wave to their alternates.

blackstar4.name: Tsubaki: Smoke Bomb
blackstar4.description: Black Star becomes invulnerable for one turn. If Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode is active, Black Star's skills will Bypass the following turn.

blackstar5.name: The Unexplored Path
blackstar5.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy. Uncounterable. Targets with active Counter effects take an additional 10 damage from this skill. If the target is currently affected by Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode, they take an additional 10 damage from this skill. Both of these effects can activate.

blackstar6.name: Shadow Star
blackstar6.description: Deals 10 damage to one enemy for 2 turns. If that enemy is affected by Tsubaki: Enchanted Sword Mode, they take 15 Piercing damage whenever they damage Black Star with a new skill.

aang1.name: Air Sphere
aang1.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy. If Aang is Air-Aligned, this deals 5 additional damage and the next skill they use will be delayed for 1 turn. If used the turn after Water Whip, this will reduce all the target's damage by 20 for 1 turn.

aang2.name: Water Whip
aang2.description: Deals 10 damage to the enemy team and reduces their affliction damage by 10 for 2 turns. If Aang is Water-Aligned, this deals 5 additional damage and reduces all damage instead. If used the turn after Earth Pillars, this will stun their Physical, Affliction, and Strategic skills the first turn it deals damage.

aang3.name: Earth Pillars
aang3.description: The next skill one enemy uses will have its damage capped at 10. If Aang is Earth-Aligned, this will cap the damage of the next 2 skills the target uses instead. If used the turn after Fire Kick, this deals 10 affliction damage to the target every turn it is active.

aang4.name: Fire Kick
aang4.description: Deals 40 affliction damage to one enemy. If Aang is Fire-Aligned, this deals 15 additional damage. If used the turn after Air Sphere, the entire enemy team is also dealt 5 affliction damage for 2 turns, Bypassing Invulnerability.

aang5.name: Avatar Cycle
aang5.description: Passive: Whenever Aang uses a skill matching his current elemental alignment, he cycles to the next elemental alignment in the following sequence: Air -> Water -> Earth -> Fire. When he completes the cycle, he gains Aang Avatar State.

korra1.name: Fire Control
korra1.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Affliction skill used by one enemy and swaps to 'Fire Fist'. Invisible.

korra10.name: Gate Open
korra10.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to the enemy team and for 2 turns the next skill they use will be delayed for 8 turns.

korra11.name: Korra Avatar State
korra11.description: Passive: If Korra uses a skill from the same element 5 times she will activate the avatar state for 4 turns: If Fire: Deals 10 affliction damage to any enemy that uses a new skill on her, If Earth: Grants 40 permanent Shield, If Water: gives 20 damage reduction, If Air: makes Korra ignore all non-damage harmful effects. While active, Earth Control and Water Control swap to 'Energybending' and 'Gate Open'. This can only occur once per game.

korra2.name: Air Control
korra2.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Mental skill used by one enemy and swaps to 'Air Wave'. Invisible.

korra3.name: Earth Control
korra3.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Physical skill used by one enemy and swaps to 'Earth Area Attack'. Invisible.

korra4.name: Water Control
korra4.description: For 1 turn, counters the first Energy skill used by one enemy and swaps to 'Water Arm Stun'. Invisible.

korra5.name: Fire Fist
korra5.description: Deals 25 Affliction damage to one enemy and increases the Affliction damage they take by 10 for 1 turn.

korra6.name: Air Wave
korra6.description: Deals 20 piercing damage to all enemies and increases the cost of their skills by 1 random energy for 1 turn.

korra7.name: Earth Area Attack
korra7.description: Destroys all enemy Shield then deals 40 damage to one enemy and 20 to all others.

korra8.name: Water Arm Stun
korra8.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy and stuns their non-Mental skills for 2 turns. Cannot be used while active.

korra9.name: Energybending
korra9.description: Korra targets an ally or an enemy. If an ally, they will permanently ignore enemy non-damage effects and if an enemy they are permanently silenced. Cannot be used on an affected character and cannot be removed.

tatsumi1.name: Killing Strike
tatsumi1.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy. If that enemy is stunned, they take 5 additional damage. If the target is below 50 health, they take 5 additional damage. Both of these effects can activate.

tatsumi2.name: Incursio
tatsumi2.description: For 3 turns, Tatsumi gains 10 points of Damage Reduction and becomes Invulnerable at the end of any turn where he doesn't use a new skill. During this time, Neuntote is usable, Killing Strike becomes Piercing damage and Tatsumi's skills will Bypass while he is Invulnerable.

tatsumi3.name: Neuntote
tatsumi3.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy, marking them permanently. Skills and effects will consider the marked enemy to be stunned.

tatsumi4.name: Invisibility
tatsumi4.description: Tatsumi becomes invunerable for 1 turn. Can only be used if Tatsumi is invunerable through Incursio's effect.

akame1.name: Red-Eyed Killer
akame1.description: Marks one enemy for two turns. During this time, One-Cut Killing may be used on them.

akame2.name: One Cut Killing
akame2.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. After two turns have passed, the damaged enemy will die. This skill can only target an enemy marked by Red-Eyed Killer.

akame3.name: Little War Horn
akame3.description: For 2 turns, Akame is invulnerable to Physical skills and she may use One Cut Killing on any target.

sheele1.name: Extase - Bisector of Creation
sheele1.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to one enemy. If that enemy has Shield, this skill deals 10 more damage. If that enemy has Damage Reduction, this skill deals 5 more damage. Both of these effects can activate.

sheele2.name: Savior Strike
sheele2.description: Deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy and ends all of that enemy's cancellable effects.

sheele3.name: Trump Card - Blinding Light
sheele3.description: For 2 turns, all enemies are Shattered. During this time, neither of Sheele's allies can be killed.

tanjiro1.name: Fourth Form: Striking Tide
tanjiro1.description: Tanjiro deals 20 piercing damage to an enemy. Swaps with 'Tenth Form: Constant Flux'.

tanjiro2.name: Third Form: Flowing Dance
tanjiro2.description: Tanjiro deals 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns, increased by 1 turn more whenever Tanjiro uses another skill during this skill. During this time, Tanjiro gains 10 points of damage reduction. This skill cannot be used while it is active and swaps with Sxith Form: Whirlpool.

tanjiro3.name: Seventh Form: Drop Ripple Thrust
tanjiro3.description: For 1 turn, Tanjiro targets his team and counters the first Harmful non-Strategic skill used on them. Countered enemies will take 5 more damage from Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin, and it will deal piercing damage to them. This skill is invisible and swaps with Eight Form: Waterfall Basin.

tanjiro4.name: Second Form: Water Wheel
tanjiro4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

tanjiro5.name: Tenth Form: Constant Flux
tanjiro5.description: Tanjiro deals 30 damage to all enemies. This skill will deal 20 additional damage for each dead enemy.

tanjiro6.name: Sixth Form: Whirlpool
tanjiro6.description: For 2 turns, Tanjiro deals 10 damage to all enemies while making his team invulnerable against Energy skills. Swaps with Third Form: Flowing Dance.

tanjiro7.name: Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin
tanjiro7.description: Tanjiro deals 30 damage to all enemies. Swaps with Seventh Form: Drop Ripple Thrust.

tanjiro8.name: Enhanced Smell
tanjiro8.description: Passive: At the end of each turn, Tanjiro's first three skills may change to their alternate versions.

nezuko1.name: Blood Demon Art
nezuko1.description: Nezuko heals another ally for 20 HP and removes all afflictions from them, or deals 20 damage to an enemy. The targeted character is permanently marked.

nezuko2.name: Demonic Frenzy
nezuko2.description: Nezuko targets every character marked by 'Blood Demon Art', casting 'Blood Demon Art' on them then healing herself 15HP for every character affected. Bypasses invulnerability.

nezuko3.name: Pyrokinesis
nezuko3.description: Deals 30 affliction damage to one enemy. If the target is marked by 'Blood Demon Art', they also are dealt an additional 5 affliction damage and then 5 the following 2 turns.

nezuko4.name: Little Nezuko!
nezuko4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

nezuko5.name: Demon Blood
nezuko5.description: Passive: When Nezuko reaches 50HP for the first time, she will heal 10HP every turn for 5 turns.

zenitsu1.name: Speed of Thunder
zenitsu1.description: Permanently, 'First Form: Thunderclap and Flash' and 'Thunder Release' will deal 5 additional damage. Until the next time it is used, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash will make Zenitsu invulnerable to non-Strategic skills for 1 turn and this skill cannot be used.

zenitsu2.name: Thunder Release
zenitsu2.description: Permanently, 'First Form: Thunderclap and Flash' and 'Thunder Release' will deal 5 additional damage. Until the next time it is used, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash will permanently make Zenitsu deal 0 piercing damage to any enemy that uses a new non-Strategic skill on him.

zenitsu3.name: First Form: Thunderclap and Flash
zenitsu3.description: Zenitsu deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy. If Zenitsu is under the effect of both Speed of Thunder and Thunder Release, he will instead deal 15 piercing damage twice.

zenitsu4.name: Falling Maneuver
zenitsu4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

rengoku1.name: Second Form: Rising Scorching Sun
rengoku1.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to the target and Shatters them until the end of Rengoku's next turn. If the target is already Shattered, Shatter them for an extra turn.

rengoku2.name: Swift Sword Slash
rengoku2.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to the target and inflicts 5 Bleed damage for 2 turns. If the target is Shattered, increase the Bleed to 10 per turn.

rengoku3.name: Fourth Form: Blooming Flame Undulation
rengoku3.description: For one turn, the first harmful skill used on your team will be countered. If triggered, the enemy team is Shattered for 1 turn.

rengoku4.name: Esoteric Art
rengoku4.description: Removes all damage effects from Rengoku. For 1 turn he will ignore Stun effects and this skill swaps to Ninth Form: Rengoku.

rengoku5.name: Ninth Form: Rengoku
rengoku5.description: Deals 40 damage to the target and inflicts 5 Bleed damage for 2 turns. If the enemy is Shattered, this bleed effect lasts an additional turn. Uncounterable.

muichiro1.name: Third Form: Scattering Mist Splash
muichiro1.description: Muichiro deals 10 damage to the enemy team. If Muichiro has 3 stacks of Third Form, he deals 15 damage instead.

muichiro5.name: Fifth Form: Sea of Clouds and Haze

meliodas1.name: Hellblaze
meliodas1.description: Deals 15 Affliction damage to target enemy. For 2 turns, they take 5 Affliction damage and cannot be healed.

meliodas2.name: Full Counter
meliodas2.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a new Harmful skill, they will be countered and receive 25 Piercing damage.

meliodas3.name: Revenge Counter
meliodas3.description: For 2 turns, Meliodas ignores harmful non-damage effects and cannot use skills (Invisible). Afterward, Meliodas can use this skill for no energy to deal 30 Piercing damage to target enemy, increased by 30 for each Harmful skill he received during this time.

meliodas4.name: Jitsuzo Bunshin
meliodas4.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies and makes Meliodas Invulnerable for 1 turn

meliodas5.name: Dragon's Sin of Wrath
meliodas5.description: Whenever an enemy uses a non-Strategic skill on one of Meliodas' allies, Meliodas deals 10 Piercing damage to them. This also occurs if Full Counter is not triggered.

diane1.name: Mother Catastrophe
diane1.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy on the following turn. This damage Bypasses and if it hits an invulnerable target, they are stunned for 1 turn. The target of this skill is invisible, and it cannot be used while active.

diane2.name: Heavy Metal
diane2.description: Diane gains 30 Shield. While the Shield holds, Mother Catastrophe will take 1 more turn to activate and deal 20 more damage. If used while Mother Catastrophe is active, this will extend and boost the active instance.

diane3.name: Queen's Embrace
diane3.description: For 2 turns, all characters gain 15 damage reduction. During this time, this skill is replaced by Ground Gladius.

diane4.name: Diane Dance
diane4.description: Diane becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. For the rest of the game, Queen's Embrace lasts 1 more turn.

diane5.name: Ground Gladius
diane5.description: Deals 30 piercing damage to an enemy affected by Queen's Embrace. Affected enemies receive 5 Bleed damage the following turn.

king1.name: Chastifold: Sunflower
king1.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy not currently affected by Disaster. When Empowered, deals 35 damage to target enemy.

king2.name: Chastifold: Increase
king2.description: Deals 5 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. When Empowered, this damage increases to 10 Piercing damage.

king3.name: True Spirit Spear Chastifold
king3.description: For 4 turns, any enemy that uses a Harmful skill on King or his allies will be affected by Disaster. During this time, his skills are Empowered and this skill is replaced by Chastifold: Pollen Garden.

king4.name: Chastifold: Guardian
king4.description: Target allied character gains 20 Shield for 1 turn. When Empowered, Reflects the next Harmful skill received for 1 turn (Invisible)

king5.name: Chastifold: Pollen Garden
king5.description: For 2 turns, if King's allies do not act, they will become Invulnerable and heal 15 HP for the remainder of this skill's duration.

king6.name: Disaster
king6.description: Any enemy that receives non-Bleed damage from King will take 10 Bleed damage next turn. This will not occur if the initial damage is absorbed or prevented.

tsunayoshi1.name: X-Burner
tsunayoshi1.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy, and 10 damage to the others.

tsunayoshi2.name: Zero Point Breakthrough
tsunayoshi2.description: For 1 turn, the first enemy to use a new Affliction or Energy skill on Tsuna is countered and stunned for 1 turn. If this move successfully counters an ability, X-Burner will deal 10 additional damage to all targets for 2 turns.

tsunayoshi3.name: Burning Axle
tsunayoshi3.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy, marking them permanently. If that enemy is damaged by X-Burner, they take 10 damage and are stunned for 1 turn, consuming the mark.

yamamoto1.name: Shinotsuku Ame
yamamoto1.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy, and lowers their damage by 10 for 2 turns (refreshes). Yamamoto gains 1 stack of Asari Ugetsu.

yamamoto2.name: Utsuhi Ame
yamamoto2.description: Targets one enemy invisibly for 1 turn. The following turn they take 15 damage that Bypasses Invulnerability and Yamamoto gains 1 stack of Asari Ugetsu. If the target used a skill this turn, they receive 15 additional damage and Yamamoto gains 2 stacks of Asari Ugetsu instead.

yamamoto3.name: Asari Ugetsu
yamamoto3.description: Consumes all stacks of Asari Ugetsu on use, and remains active for one turn plus one per stack consumed. While active, replaces Shinotsuku Ame with Scontro di Rondine and Utsuhi Ame with Beccata di Rondine, and Yamamoto gains 25 Shield.

yamamoto5.name: Scontro di Rondine
yamamoto5.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy, increased by 5 for each damage reducing effect on them.

yamamoto6.name: Beccata di Rondine
yamamoto6.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage to the enemy team and lowers their damage by 5 for 3 turns.

ryohei1.name: Maximum Cannon
ryohei1.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy. This skill deals 15 additional damage and costs 1 additional random for every stack of To the Extreme!!, consuming all stacks on use.

ryohei2.name: Kangaryu
ryohei2.description: Heals your entire team for 10. This skill lasts 1 additional turn and costs 1 additional random for every stack of To the Extreme!!, consuming all stacks on use.

ryohei3.name: Vongola Headgear
ryohei3.description: For 3 turns, Ryohei will ignore harmful stun effects and changes to his ability costs. During this time, Maximum Cannon becomes piercing and Kangaryu also grants 10 damage reduction every turn it is active.

ryohei4.name: To the Extreme!!
ryohei4.description: For the rest of the game, whenever Ryohei receives 20 total damage, he gains a stack of To The Extreme!!, empowering his abilities.

squalo1.name: Zanna di Squalo
squalo1.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy for 3 turns (Bypasses)

squalo2.name: Scontro di Squalo
squalo2.description: Removes all Nullify from Squalo, all Shield from target enemy, then deals 20 Piercing damage to them.

squalo3.name: Squalo Grande Pioggia
squalo3.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy and permanently Shatters them.

xanxus1.name: Scoppio d'Ira
xanxus1.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy. This skill gains the following bonus effects, corresponding to the effects that have triggered Scars of Wrath: Received a stun effect -> Stuns the targeted enemy for 1 turn. Received Piercing damage -> Deals Piercing damage. Received Affliction damage -> Applies 5 permanent Affliction damage.

xanxus2.name: Martello di Fiamma
xanxus2.description: Deals 35 damage to one enemy. This skill gains the following bonus effects, corresponding to the effects that have triggered Scars of Wrath: Been Countered -> Uncounterable. Been reduced below half health -> Deals 20 damage to other enemy targets.

xanxus3.name: Flames of Wrath
xanxus3.description: For 1 turn, Xanxus can trigger Scars of Wrath as though it had not yet been triggered by any effects this game. Invisible.

xanxus4.name: Sky Flame Deflection
xanxus4.description: Makes Xanxus invulnerable for 1 turn. This gains the following bonus effects, corresponding to the effects that have triggered Scars of Wrath: Received Affliction damage -> Heals Xanxus 15 health. Received a Shatter effect -> Gives Xanxus 25 Shield. Received an Isolate effect -> Fully cleanses Xanxus.

xanxus5.name: Scars of Wrath
xanxus5.description: Passive: The first time Xanxus receives normal damage, Scoppio d'Ira permanently deals 5 more damage, Martello di Flamma costs 1 less Random energy, and Sky Flame Deflection has 1 less cooldown. The same is true for receiving Piercing damage, receiving Affliction damage, being stunned, being countered, being shattered, being isolated, and being reduced below half health.

eren1.name: Reckless Charge
eren1.description: Eren deals 35 damage to one enemy and loses 5 health. This skill will deal 5 additional damage to both Eren and his target each time it's used.

eren2.name: Sacrificial Save
eren2.description: Eren targets one ally, reflecting all harmful skills used on them to himself for 2 turns. This skill is invisible.

eren3.name: Titan Transformation
eren3.description: Eren marks one selected enemy and one random enemy. This skill stacks and cannot be removed. When Eren's health reaches 40 or below all marked enemies will take 10 damage for every stack they have. When triggered, Eren will heal 5 health for each stack of this skill and all of his skills swap to alternates for the rest of the game. This skill is invisible.

eren4.name: Eren Rampage
eren4.description: Eren deals 20 damage to one random enemy and becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill becomes 'Titan Eren Assault' when 'Titan Transformation' activates.

eren5.name: Titan Eren Assault
eren5.description: Titan Eren assaults one enemy, dealing 25 damage to them and becoming invulnerable afterwards.

eren7.name: Titan KO
eren7.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy and fully stuns them for 1 turn.

mikasa1.name: Titan Takedown
mikasa1.description: Mikasa Ackerman deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered or reflected. If the target is affected by a stun then this deals 5 additional damage to them.

mikasa2.name: Rallying Call
mikasa2.description: For 1 turn, Mikasa and her allies cannot be killed. This skill will last 1 additional turn with each use.

mikasa3.name: Maneuvering Gear
mikasa3.description: Mikasa and a selected ally ignore Harmful, non-damage effects for 1 turn. Swaps to 'Thunder Spear' while active. This effect is invisible.

mikasa4.name: Unlikely Savior
mikasa4.description: Mikasa becomes invulnerable and stuns target enemy's non-Strategic skills until the end of Mikasa's next turn.

mikasa5.name: Thunder Spear
mikasa5.description: Destroys one enemy's Shield, deals 25 piercing damage to them, then stuns their strategic skills for 1 turn.

saitama1.name: Normal Punch
saitama1.description: Destroys one enemy's Shield then deals 45 damage to them. Swaps with 'Consecutive Normal Punches' at the end of the turn.

saitama3.name: Serious Series: Serious Table-Flip
saitama3.description: Saitama removes all harmful skills from his team. For 1 turn, Saitama's team becomes Invulnerable and for 2 turns the enemy team becomes Shattered. Swaps to 'Serious Series: Omni-Directional Serious Punch' permanently.

saitama4.name: Serious Series: Serious Side-Hops
saitama4.description: For 1 turn, the first non-strategic enemy harmful skill used on Saitama will be countered. If successful, Saitama gains 1 green energy, the enemy is marked, and this swaps to 'Serious Series: Serious Punch' for 1 turn. Invisible.

saitama2.name: Consecutive Normal Punches
saitama2.description: Destroys the enemy team's Shield and deals 30 damage to them. Swaps with with 'Normal Punch' at the end of the turn.

saitama5.name: Serious Series: Serious Punch
saitama5.mastery_name: Don't Bother Me While I'm Shopping
saitama5.description: The enemy marked by 'Serious Series: Serious Side-Hops' is instantly killed. Uncounterable, unreflectable.

genos1.name: Machine-Gun Blows
genos1.description: Deals 5 damage to one enemy twice. The next time this skill is used it will deal Affliction damage instead* then permanently increase this skill's damage by 5 and revert back to Normal damage (stacks).

genos2.name: Lightning Eye
genos2.description: For 1 turn, the enemy team is Shattered, Blinded, and take 5 additional damage from all sources. 'Rocket Boosters' has its cooldown reset and is improved for 1 turn.

genos3.name: Super Incineration Cannon
genos3.description: Deals 10 Affliction damage to one enemy for 3 turns. Any enemy to use a new Affliction skill on Genos during this time will recieve 10 Affliction damage. While active, this skill swaps to 'Lightning Drill Cannon'.

genos4.name: Rocket Boosters
genos4.description: This skill makes Genos invulnerable for 1 turn. If improved, for 2 turns, this skill will swap to 'Self-Destruct'.

genos5.name: Lightning Drill Cannon
genos5.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy and fully stuns them for 1 turn.

tatsumaki1.name: Psychic Shear
tatsumaki1.description: Deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their Harmful skills until the end of Tatsumaki's next turn.

tatsumaki2.name: Psychokinetic Bind
tatsumaki2.description: Applies 20 Nullify to one enemy. If Nullify from Psychokinetic Bind exists on a different enemy, Tatsumaki will slam them together. If there is an enemy between them, this deals damage to them equal to their total Nullify and stuns the enemy for 2 turns. If not, their total Nullify is split between affected enemies and they are both stunned for 1 turn. This removes all Nullify from affected targets and bypasses invulnerability.

tatsumaki3.name: Extreme Psychic Twisting
tatsumaki3.description: Deals 30 damage to all enemies. Stunned enemies have the duration of their stun effects increased by 1 turn. Swaps to Spear of Green Light for 3 turns.

tatsumaki4.name: Tatsumaki Barrier
tatsumaki4.description: Tatsumaki becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. Swaps with City-Wide Barrier for 4 turns.

tatsumaki5.name: Spear of Green Light
tatsumaki5.description: Targets a currently stunned character, dealing 75 damage to them.

tatsumaki6.name: City-Wide Barrier
tatsumaki6.description: Tatsumaki's team becomes invulnerable for 2 turns.

shinra1.name: Ignition: Shinra
shinra1.description: For one turn, Shinra's damaging skills will cost one less Green energy and apply 5 permanent affliction damage.

shinra2.name: Rapid Kick
shinra2.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

shinra3.name: Tora Hishigi
shinra3.description: Deals 40 damage to one enemy and stuns them for one turn.

shinra4.name: Adolla Burst
shinra4.description: Shinra becomes invulnerable for one turn.

shinra5.name: Hysterical Strength
shinra5.description: Passive: When Shinra falls to 40 health for the first time each game, he will permanently become Isolated and Ignition: Shinra will be reapplied to Shinra each time he uses a new Harmful skill.

tamaki1.name: Nekomata Blaze
tamaki1.description: Tamaki deals 15 affliction damage to one enemy, increased by 5 for every damage over time effect on them. If the target is affected by Nekomata Cage, this skill Bypasses Invulnerability. Afterwards, causes the enemy to take 5 affliction damage permanently, stacking.

tamaki2.name: Nekomata Cage
tamaki2.description: Tamaki targets one enemy for three turns. During this time, if they use a new harmful skill they will receive 5 affliction damage per turn for the rest of the game.

tamaki3.name: Ignition: Nekomata
tamaki3.description: Tamaki gains 15 permanent Shield and for the next 3 turns, she will ignore enemy non-damage effects and Nekomata Cage will target all enemies. This skill becomes Nekomata Fireball while active.

tamaki4.name: Fearless Defender
tamaki4.description: Tamaki gains 10 points of damage reduction for 1 turn, and reflects all Harmful skills used on target ally to herself.

tamaki5.name: Nekomata Fireball
tamaki5.description: Tamaki deals 30 affliction damage to one target, increased by 5 for every damage over time effect on them. If the target is affected by Nekomata Cage, this skill ignores invulnerability. Afterwards, applies three stacks of 5 permanent affliction damage to the enemy.

gon1.name: Jajanken Stance
gon1.description: Gon gains 10 Shield and his skills will deal 10 more damage permanently and are improved. This skill stacks & will end if Gon uses a Damaging Skill.

gon2.name: Jajanken Rock
gon2.description: Deals 30 damage to one enemy. This skill will stun if Gon has 'Jajanken Stance' active.

gon3.name: Jajanken Paper
gon3.description: Deals 10 Damage to the enemy team. This skill will instead cost 1 Random, become piercing, and Blind its targets if 'Jajanken Stance' is active.

gon4.name: Jajanken Scissors
gon4.description: Gon Freecss executes an enemy at 25HP or below. If Gon has stacks of Jajanken Stance, this skill will first deal 10 damage for every stack of 'Jajanken Stance' Gon has.

killua1.name: Claws Assassination
killua1.description: Killua deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy and gives them one stack of Decapitation. The following 2 turns, this skill and Heart Ripper will deal 10 additional damage.

killua2.name: Heart Ripper
killua2.description: Killua deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy, stuns them for 1 turn, and gives them 1 stack of Decapitation.

killua3.name: Decapitation
killua3.description: Killua detonates all Decapitation Counters on an enemy, dealing 15 affliction damage for each counter detonated. Affected enemies are Executed if their health falls to 20 or below.

killua4.name: Killua Hide
killua4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

kurapika1.name: Bokken Smash
kurapika1.description: Destroys all of one enemy's Shield and deals 30 damage to them.

kurapika2.name: Chain Jail
kurapika2.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy, stuns their non-Mental skills and marks them for 1 turn. Swaps to Judgement Chain for 1 turn.

kurapika3.name: Holy Chain
kurapika3.description: Removes all enemy harmful effects from Kurapika or an ally and heals them 35HP.

kurapika4.name: Scarlet Eyes
kurapika4.description: Kurapika will ignore the next new enemy damage he receives. Invisible. While active, this skill cannot be used and Bokken Smash deals 10 more damage.

kurapika5.name: Judgement Chain
kurapika5.description: The enemy marked by 'Chain Jail' is targeted until Kurapika dies. If they use 3 new skills, they will be instantly killed. While active, every turn the target does not use a new skill, they will take 10 affliction damage and lose 1 energy. May not be used while active. Unremovable.

hisoka1.name: Card Throw
hisoka1.description: Deals 5 Piercing damage to target enemy, then gives Hisoka 1 stack of Card Throw. Afterward, Hisoka deals 5 Piercing damage to a random enemy for each stack of Card Throw he has. If Hisoka has at least 5 stacks of Card Throw, this skill is replaced with Flamboyant Execution.

hisoka2.name: Bungee Gum - Attract
hisoka2.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and Taunts them for 1 turn.

hisoka3.name: Texture Surprise
hisoka3.description: Hisoka marks target character for 3 turns. During this time, your opponent will not see any changes made to that character's HP.

hisoka4.name: Bungee Gum - Catch
hisoka4.description: For 1 turn, Hisoka will ignore any Harmful skill used on him (Invisible). Afterward, this skill is replaced by Bungee Gum - Reflect.

hisoka5.name: Bungee Gum - Reflect
hisoka5.description: Hisoka uses any skills that he ignored with Bungee Gum - Catch on target enemy.

hisoka6.name: Flamboyant Execution
hisoka6.description: Hisoka executes target enemy. Can only target the enemy with the lowest current HP.

misaka1.name: Iron Sand
misaka1.description: Misaka grants one ally 20 points of Shield for 1 turn. After being used, this ability will be replaced by Iron Colossus for 1 turn.

misaka2.name: Railgun
misaka2.description: Misaka deals 20 damage to one enemy. This ability ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected. After being used, this ability will be replaced by Ultra Railgun for 1 turn.

misaka3.name: Overcharge
misaka3.description: For one turn, each time Misaka takes new damage she will permanently deal 5 more damage with Railgun and apply 5 more Shield with Iron Sand.

misaka4.name: Electric Deflection
misaka4.description: Misaka becomes invulnerable for one turn.

misaka5.name: Iron Colossus
misaka5.description: Misaka makes her team invulnerable for 1 turn. For the rest of the game, Iron Sand and Railgun affect all valid targets. Using this ability will reset all her abilities to their original forms and prevent her from switching for the rest of the game.

misaka6.name: Ultra Railgun
misaka6.description: Misaka deals 40 damage to target enemy. This ability Bypasses Invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected. For the rest of the game, Iron Sand and Railgun cost one additional random energy and have their base effects doubled. Using this ability will reset all her abilities to their original forms and prevent her from switching for the rest of the game.

kuroko1.name: Judgement Throw
kuroko1.description: Kuroko deals 20 damage to one enemy and Silences them for one turn. If used on the turn after Teleporting Strike, this skill will stun its target for 1 turn. If used on the turn after Needle Pin, this skill will remove one energy from its target.

kuroko2.name: Teleporting Strike
kuroko2.description: Kuroko deals 15 damage to one enemy and becomes invulnerable for one turn. If used on the turn after Needle Pin, this ability will have no cooldown. If used on the turn after Judgement Throw, this ability will deal 15 extra damage.

kuroko3.name: Needle Pin
kuroko3.description: One enemy becomes Shattered for two turns. If used on the turn after Teleporting Strike, this skill Bypasses and deals 20 piercing damage to its target. If used on the turn after Judgement Throw, this skill will Isolate its target for one turn.

saber1.name: Excalibur
saber1.description: Saber deals 45 piercing damage to one enemy and Silences them for one turn. This skill cannot be countered or reflected and starts the game on cooldown.

saber2.name: Wind Blade Combat
saber2.description: Saber deals 20 damage to one enemy and ignores stun effects for one turn. If used while costing Green energy, for 1 turn this skill will cost 1 Random energy. If used while costing random energy, for 1 turn this skill will cost nothing. This skill cannot be countered.

saber3.name: Avalon
saber3.description: One ally permanently heals 10 health per turn. Once active, Saber can reactivate this skill to reflect all new harmful effects received by that ally to herself for one turn.

saber4.name: Providence
saber4.description: Saber or the target of her Avalon become invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill always costs the same energy as Wind Blade Combat.

gilgamesh1.name: Gate of Babylon
gilgamesh1.description: If used on Gilgamesh, adds one stack of Gate of Babylon. If used on an enemy, deals 10 damage to that enemy, then consumes all stacks of Gate of Babylon from Gilgamesh to repeat this effect once per stack consumed.

gilgamesh2.name: Enkidu, Chains of Heaven
gilgamesh2.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a new Harmful skill, they will be countered. Next turn, that enemy's skills and effects do not deal damage or healing. This effect is invisible until triggered.

gilgamesh3.name: Enuma Elish
gilgamesh3.description: Deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy and for 1 turn, that enemy's skills and effects do not deal damage or healing.

gilgamesh4.name: Gate of Babylon - Interception
gilgamesh4.description: Gilgamesh becomes invulnerable for one turn. This skill requires 1 stack of Gate of Babylon to be used, and consumes that stack on use.

emiyaarcher1.name: Caladbolg Barrage
emiyaarcher1.description: Deals 10 True damage to target enemy 2 times. During Hawkeye, this skill deals 10 True damage 3 times. This skill counts as 2 skill uses, or 3 during Hawkeye.

emiyaarcher2.name: Hawkeye
emiyaarcher2.description: EMIYA becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. On the following turn, his skills are empowered. This skill's remaining cooldown is decreased by 1 each time any character uses a skill.

emiyaarcher3.name: Twinblade Rush
emiyaarcher3.description: Deals 35 damage to target enemy. While Empowered, deals 20 damage and 20 True damage, and counts as 2 skill uses.

emiyaarcher5.name: Grand Caladbolg
emiyaarcher5.description: Once Emiya has used 12 skills, his next Caladbolg Barrage deals 50 True damage to its target and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

jack1.name: Maria The Ripper
jack1.description: Jack deals 10 normal damage and 10 affliction damage to one enemy. Can only target Isolated enemies or enemies affected by Fog of London.

jack2.name: Fog of London
jack2.description: Jack deals 5 affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, they will receive 50% reduced healing. This skill cannot be countered.

jack3.name: We Are Jack
jack3.description: Deals 30 affliction damage to target Isolated enemy that is also affected by Fog of London.

jack4.name: Smokescreen Ambush
jack4.description: Jack deals 15 damage to target enemy and becomes Invulnerable for one turn. If this targets an Isolated enemy or an enemy affected by Fog of London, its cooldown is reduced by 2. Both of these effects can occur.

jack5.name: Streets of the Lost
jack5.description: Passive: At the end of any turn in which an enemy is the only character to act, or is the only character to not act, that enemy is Isolated for 1 turn.

semiramis1.name: Chains of the First Poisoner
semiramis1.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their Helpful and Strategic skills for 1 turn.

semiramis2.name: Mystical Beast - Hydra
semiramis2.description: Deals 10 Affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. Affected enemies can remove this effect by ending their turn while Invulnerable, and if it expires normally, the target is stunned for 1 turn.

semiramis3.name: Arrogant King's Poison
semiramis3.description: Semiramis deals 5 permanent Affliction damage to all enemies. Upon use, all active enemy Shield, Invulnerability, or heal-over-time effects are converted into additional stacks of 5 permanent Affliction damage. This skill Bypasses.

semiramis5.name: Hanging Gardens of Babylon
semiramis5.description: Semiramis begins the game banished for 2 turns. She returns to the game with 25 permanent Shield, and gains 1 random energy.

frankenstein1.name: Bridal Chest
frankenstein1.description: Deals 20 damage to one enemy, and increases the remaining cooldown of one of their skills by 1.

frankenstein2.name: Bridal Rampage
frankenstein2.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies. The following 2 turns, Frankenstein will ignore non-damage effects and will use Bridal Chest on a random enemy every turn.

frankenstein3.name: Blasted Tree
frankenstein3.description: Frankenstein self-destructs, dealing damage equal to her missing HP in Piercing damage to target enemy.

frankenstein4.name: Galvanism
frankenstein4.description: For the next 4 turns, Frankenstein will heal 15 HP any time she is affected by a new Energy skill, and Bridal Chest's cooldown increasing effect is increased by 1.

mash1.name: Flying Galahad
mash1.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy, increased by 10 for each 20 Shield currently on Mash. After A Knight That Protects ends, this skill becomes Around Round Axe for 1 turn.

mash2.name: Around Round Crash
mash2.description: Mash deals 15 damage to all enemies and taunts her primary target for 1 turn. After a Knight That Protects ends, this skills costs 1 less Random for 1 turn.

mash3.name: Lord Camelot
mash3.description: Mash's teammates become invulnerable for 2 turns.

mash4.name: A Knight That Protects
mash4.description: Mash targets one of her allies, making them permanently invulnerable to non-Strategic skills and reflecting all harmful skills used on them to herself. During this time, Mash gains 30 Shield and this skill is replaced by Shield of White Walls. This effect will end if the Shield is destroyed.

mash5.name: Around Round Axe
mash5.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If the damaged enemy is the enemy that broke the Shield from A Knight That Protects last turn, this skill deals 5 more damage and stuns its target for 1 turn.

mash6.name: Shield of White Walls
mash6.description: Mash increases the remaining Shield on A Knight That Protects by 25, up to a maximum of 40.

ryuko1.name: Fiber Lost
ryuko1.description: Ryuko deals 20 damage to one enemy and caps their damage at 20 for one turn. If this skill kills an enemy, Ryuko will heal 10 health and permanently deal 10 additional damage.

ryuko2.name: Decapitation Mode
ryuko2.description: Fiber Lost and Life Fiber Synchronization will target all valid characters, but will cost 1 additional random energy. This skill may be used while active to toggle the effect off.

ryuko3.name: Life Fiber Synchronization
ryuko3.description: For the next 2 turns, whenever an ally receives new damage, they will heal for that amount over the next 2 turns.

satsuki1.name: Effortless Precision
satsuki1.description: Deals 15 piercing damage to one enemy. If Satsuki is at full health, this ability deals 10 additional damage.

satsuki2.name: Overwhelming Power
satsuki2.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy. If Satsuki is at full health, the target's Harmful skills are stunned for 1 turn.

satsuki3.name: Perfect Crescent
satsuki3.description: Deals 35 damage to one enemy. If Satsuki is at full health, this skill Bypasses and deals 15 more damage.

satsuki4.name: Disdainful Block
satsuki4.description: Satsuki becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. If Satsuki is at full health, this skill has a 2 turn reduced cooldown.

satsuki5.name: Flawless Restoration
satsuki5.description: Satsuki receives 5 more healing from all sources. Additionally, Satsuki heals herself for 0 HP each turn.

nonon1.name: Flute Missile
nonon1.description: Nonon deals 10 Piercing damage to one enemy and increases all non-Affliction damage they take by 5 for two turns.

nonon2.name: Overture Barrage
nonon2.description: Nonon deals 10 Piercing damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, this skill swaps to Concentrated Climax.

nonon3.name: Concentrated Climax
nonon3.description: Nonon deals 10 Piercing damage to one enemy for 3 turns. If the target is affected by Overture Barrage, this skill Bypasses. Becomes Unstoppable Performance while active.

nonon4.name: Sound Negation
nonon4.description: Nonon becomes invulnerable for one turn.

nonon5.name: Unstoppable Performance
nonon5.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy, 10 Piercing damage to all enemies affected by Overture Barrage, and 10 Piercing damage to any enemy affected by Concentrated Climax.

ichigo1.name: Zangetsu Slash
ichigo1.description: Ichigo deals 20 damage to one enemy. This skill will deal 5 additional damage every time it is used.

ichigo4.name: Ichigo Block
ichigo4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

ichigo3.name: Bankai: Tensa Zangetsu
ichigo3.description: Each time Ichigo uses a skill, he permanently deals 5 more damage (stacking).

ichigo2.name: Getsuga Tenshou
ichigo2.description: Ichigo deals 45 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Ichigo becomes invulnerable to non-Strategic skills and gains 1 random energy. This skill will deal 5 additional damage for each time 'Hollow Slayer' and 'Getsuga Tenshou' were used.

byakuya1.name: Scatter, Senbonzakura
byakuya1.description: Byakuya deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy each turn for the rest of the game. While active, this skill costs 1 Red energy and can be used to change its target or deal 20 Piercing damage to the currently affected target. Bypasses Invulnerability.

byakuya2.name: Bakudo #61: Six-Rod Light Restraint
byakuya2.description: Target enemy is Shattered and Stunned for 2 turns. During this time, this skill is replaced by Hado #4: Pale Lightning.

byakuya3.name: Senka
byakuya3.description: Byakuya targets an enemy for 1 turn. If they don't use a new skill during this time, Byakuya will deal 15 Piercing damage to them and permanently lower their damage by 5 at the end of the next turn. This skill is invisible.

byakuya5.name: Bankai: Senbonzakura Kageyoshi
byakuya5.description: Passive: After using 4 skills Byakuya will release his Bankai, applying Scatter, Senbonzakura to all enemies and making it target all enemies for the rest of the game. During this time, Bakudo #61: Six-Rod Light Restraint is replaced by White Imperial Sword.

byakuya6.name: Hado #4: Pale Lightning
byakuya6.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy.

byakuya7.name: White Imperial Sword
byakuya7.description: Deals 90 Piercing damage split between all living enemies. Bypasses invulnerability.

nimaiya1.name: Unblockable Strike
nimaiya1.description: Deals 10 True damage to target enemy, then 5 True damage for each other time this skill has been used during this battle. Bypasses.

nimaiya2.name: Sheath Dodger
nimaiya2.description: Deals 5 True damage to target enemy for 4 turns. During this time, that enemy takes 5 more damage from Unblockable Strike and Oetsu is invulnerable to Strategic skills. Bypasses.

nimaiya3.name: God of the Sword
nimaiya3.description: Targets either of Oetsu's allies. The first time this skill is used on them, they permanently ignore Counter and Reflect skills. The second time, their cooldowns are permanently reduced by 1. The third time, their skills permanently cost 1 less Random energy.

nimaiya4.name: Perfect Stance
nimaiya4.description: For 1 turn, Oetsu ignores all harmful effects. Invisible.

ganta1.name: Ganta Gun
ganta1.description: Deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. This deals 5 more damage for each stack of his passive already on him.

ganta2.name: Supersonic Ganta Gun
ganta2.description: Deals 10 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill deals 5 more damage per 20 health Ganta is missing and 5 more damage per 20 health the target is missing.

ganta3.name: Ganbare Gun
ganta3.description: Ganta deals 45 damage to one enemy, then 25 damage to all enemies, and then 15 damage to his entire team. This skill is only usable if Ganta is at 10 health or below. This threshold increases by 5 for each stack of his passive that is active on Ganta.

ganta4.name: Reckless Rush
ganta4.description: For one turn, Ganta receives 5 additional damage from non-Affliction sources. During this time, Ganta cannot die and if an enemy deals new damage to Ganta, Ganta's skills will Bypass Invulnerability and deal 10 additional damage against them for 1 turn.

ganta5.name: Branch of Sin: Woodpecker
ganta5.description: Passive: Whenever Ganta uses a harmful skill, he takes 3 affliction damage per turn for 5 turns.

shiro1.name: Shiro Kick
shiro1.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shiro's other damaging skills will also stun their target's non-strategic skills for 1 turn and deal 10 additional damage.

shiro2.name: Mascot Rush
shiro2.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shiro's other damaging skills will also Silence the target for 1 turn and deal 10 additional damage.

shiro3.name: Shiro Rampage
shiro3.description: Deals 15 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shiro's other damaging skills will make her ignore stun and silence effects for 2 turns and deal 10 additional damage.

shiro4.name: Ganta Fight Song
shiro4.description: Shiro permanently taunts the enemy team. During this time, Shiro takes 5 additional damage from new skills and she gains one stack of Ganta Fever each turn this skill remains active. Channeled.

shiro5.name: Ganta Fever
shiro5.description: Passive: Whenever Shiro uses a damaging skill, she will consume one stack of Ganta Fever to extend that skill's improvement effect for two turns.

ken1.name: Tentacle Pierce
ken1.description: Kaneki deals 5 bleed damage to one enemy next turn. This skill deals 5 additional damage every time it is used.

ken2.name: Disembowel
ken2.description: Kaneki deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and any bleed currently active on them becomes permanent.

ken3.name: Bloodthirsty Rampage
ken3.description: Kaneki ignores Harmful, non-damaging effects for 3 turns. During this time, Kaneki will use Tentacle Pierce on any enemy that uses a new harmful skill on him.

ken4.name: Tentacle Block
ken4.description: This skill makes this character invulnerable for 1 turn.

touka1.name: Ukaku Slam
touka1.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies. Deals 5 additional damage to an enemy affected by 'Crystallized Shards'. This skill deals 20 additional damage and fully stuns for 1 turn during 'Crystallized Ukaku'.

touka2.name: Crystallized Shards
touka2.description: Touka deals 5 piercing damage to all enemies and increases their cooldowns by 1 for 2 turns. This deals 15 additional damage during 'Crystallized Ukaku'.

touka3.name: Crystallized Ukaku
touka3.description: Touka gains 20 Shield, makes her skills single-target, and deals 5 damage to all enemies every turn for 2 turns.

touka4.name: Touka Observation
touka4.description: Touka becomes invulnerable and increases her damage by 5 for 1 turn.

rimuru1.name: Black Flame
rimuru1.description: Deals 20 Affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

rimuru2.name: Gluttony
rimuru2.description: Rimuru marks an enemy for 1 turn. If they use a new skill, it will be copied and the target will have their cooldowns paralyzed for 2 turns. Invisible. Swaps to 'Beezlebuth' during 'Passive: Demon Lord Awakening'.

rimuru3.name: Megiddo
rimuru3.description: Rimuru deals 25 Affliction damage to the enemy team and 5 Affliction damage permanently, then swaps Rimuru's first 3 skills to their alternate versions. Unremovable.

rimuru4.name: Slime Transformation
rimuru4.description: Rimuru ignores harmful non-damage effects and heals 15 health for 2 turns. While active, this swaps to 'Demon Summon' and it is the only skill that may be used.

edward1.name: Destruction Alchemy
edward1.description: Deals 45 Affliction damage to one enemy and caps their health.

edward2.name: Defensive Alchemy
edward2.description: Grants target ally 20 Shield or target enemy 20 Nullify. For 1 turn, Destruction Alchemy costs 2 random energy, but deals 10 less damage.

edward3.name: Battle Alchemy
