edward3.description: Grants an ally 10 more non-affliction damage until the end of the turn. Next turn, Defensive Alchemy has no cost, but grants 10 less Shield/Nullify.

edward4.name: Fullmetal Alchemy
edward4.description: Edward becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. After being used, for the next 4 turns this skill can be used to deal 20 piercing damage to one enemy.

edward5.name: Free Transmutation
edward5.description: Passive: Whenever Edward uses Defensive Alchemy or Destruction Alchemy while they are improved, he gains 1 random energy, then this effect is disabled for 3 turns.

alphonse1.name: Transmutation Circle
alphonse1.description: Alphonse gains 1 random energy, permanently swaps this skill to Ground Pillars, and enables the use of Weapon Alchemy and Destruction Alchemy Strike.

alphonse2.name: Weapon Alchemy
alphonse2.description: The next time target ally deals new damage, they deal 15 piercing damage to their primary target. Cannot target a currently affected ally.

alphonse3.name: Destruction Alchemy Strike
alphonse3.description: Deals 20 affliction damage to one enemy, removes 1 random energy from them, and marks them for 2 turns. Cannot be used on marked targets, and requires Transmutation Circle to be used.

alphonse4.name: Golem Armor
alphonse4.description: Passive: Alphonse starts the game with 30 Shield. He can use this skill to refresh the Shield to 30 points and gain 5 permanent damage reduction (stacks).

alphonse5.name: Ground Pillars
alphonse5.description: Deals 15 damage to all enemies and Shatters them until the end of the turn.

goku1.name: Kamehameha
goku1.description: Deals 35 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, this skill costs 1 blue energy and deals 15 less damage, then resets back to its original cost and damage.

goku2.name: Kaioken x20
goku2.description: Goku gains 10 points of damage reduction and takes 5 affliction damage every turn for 3 turns. While active, this swaps to Kaioken Rush and Kamehameha deals 10 additional damage, becomes piercing, and deals 5 affliction damage to Goku.

goku3.name: Spirit Bomb
goku3.description: Deals 60 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns them for 1 turn. Each time Goku uses the reduced cost version of Kamehameha, this skill costs 1 less Blue energy until the next time it's used. Bypassing.

goku5.name: Kaioken Rush
goku5.description: Deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and 10 affliction damage to himself.

vegeta1.name: Ki Blast
vegeta1.description: Deals 5 piercing damage to one enemy and reduces their non-Affliction damage equal to this skill's damage for 1 turn. Gains 5 more damage each turn that Vegeta does not use a damaging skill that resets on this skill's next use (stacks).

vegeta2.name: Double Ki Blast
vegeta2.description: Vegeta gains one stack of Ki Blast, then uses Ki Blast on the enemy team.

vegeta3.name: Galick Gun
vegeta3.description: Deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill deals 5 additional damage every time it's used. Uncounterable.

vegeta4.name: Energy Charge
vegeta4.description: Vegeta gains 10 points of damage reduction for 1 turn. If he doesn't have a new Harmful skill used on him during this time, he reduces the cost of Galick Gun by 1 Red energy until the next time it's used (stacks).

gatomon1.name: Lightning Paw
gatomon1.description: Gatomon deals 15 damage to 1 enemy and Blinds their Helpful skills for 1 turn. Gatomon gains 1 stack of 'Digivolution'.

gatomon10.name: Eden's Javelin
gatomon10.description: Ophanimon deals 30 Piercing damage to 1 enemy and fully blinds their skills for 2 turns.

gatomon11.name: Sefirot Crystal
gatomon11.description: Ophanimon deals 10 damage 9 times to random enemies. Bypasses Invulnerability.

gatomon12.name: Final Judgement
gatomon12.description: Ophanimon deals 30 True damage to the enemy team and fully blinds their skills for 1 turn. If any enemy uses any skills during this time, this effect is extended by 1 turn for the entire enemy team.

gatomon13.name: Holy Light
gatomon13.description: Ophanimon becomes invulnerable for 1 turn and removes all harmful skills from her team. This skill shares a cooldown with Nekodamashi.

gatomon14.name: Eden's Air
gatomon14.description: Passive: Ophanimon heals 10 HP per turn and gains 10 permanent damage reduction.

gatomon2.name: Cat's Eye
gatomon2.description: Gatomon deals 20 damage to target enemy and paralyzes their cooldowns for 1 turn. Gatomon gains 1 stack of 'Digivolution'.

gatomon3.name: Gatomon Digivolve
gatomon3.description: Gatomon digivolves based on her Digivolution stacks, replacing her skills for the rest of the game. If used with 2 stacks of Digivolution, Gatomon will digivolve into Angewomon. If used with 3 stacks, Gatomon will digivolve into Ophanimon. This skill is usable while stunned.

gatomon4.name: Nekodamashi
gatomon4.description: Gatomon becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn and gains one stack of Digivolution. This skill shares a cooldown with Angel Wings and Holy Light.

gatomon5.name: Holy Slap
gatomon5.description: Angewomon deals 25 damage to 1 enemy and Blinds their Harmful skills for 1 turn.

gatomon6.name: Celestial Arrow
gatomon6.description: Angewomon deals 25 true damage to 1 enemy.

gatomon7.name: Heaven's Charm
gatomon7.description: Target ally heals 10 HP and gains 10 Shield and 10 DR for 1 turn.

gatomon8.name: Angel Wings
gatomon8.description: Angewomon becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill shares a cooldown with Nekodamashi.

gatomon9.name: Saint Air
gatomon9.description: Passive: Angewomon will heal 5 HP every turn.

myotismon1.name: Grisly Wing
myotismon1.description: Deals 10 Piercing damage to target enemy and marks them for 3 turns. Myotismon heals for any damage dealt by this skill.

myotismon2.name: Crimson Lightning
myotismon2.description: Deals 35 damage to target enemy. If they are marked by Grisly Wing, they will permanently ignore healing effects.

myotismon3.name: Disintegrate
myotismon3.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a new Helpful skill, they will be countered and banished for 1 turn. If the target is marked by Grisly Wing, they will be banished for 2 turns instead.

machinedramon1.name: Giga Cannon
machinedramon1.description: Deals 35 damage to one enemy, removes 1 random energy from them, and Taunts them for 1 turn.

machinedramon2.name: Giga Destroyer
machinedramon2.description: Deals 35 Affliction damage to one enemy, Taunts them for 1 turn, and stuns their Physical skills for 2 turns.

machinedramon3.name: Infinite Hand
machinedramon3.description: Deals 15 damage to the enemy team for 3 turns. During this time, any enemy that uses a harmful skill on a target other than Machinedramon will be Taunted by him for 1 turn.

machinedramon4.name: EMP Wave
machinedramon4.description: Machinedramon becomes invulnerable for 1 turn and gains 1 Blue energy.

machinedramon5.name: Catastrophe Day
machinedramon5.description: Passive: The first time Machinedramon's health falls below 20, at the end of his next turn, he will deal 25 damage to all targetable characters and then die.

gallantmon1.name: Gallant Guard
gallantmon1.description: Counters the first Harmful, non-Strategic skill used against one ally for 1 turn. If this skill expires without being triggered, it swaps to Shield of the Just for 1 turn. For 1 turn, Lightning Joust will strike twice.

gallantmon2.name: Lightning Joust
gallantmon2.description: Gallantmon deals 20 Piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Shield of the Just will reflect instead of counter. If this skill is countered, it will be replaced by Shield of the Just for 1 turn.

gallantmon3.name: Yuggoth Blaster
gallantmon3.description: Gallantmon deals 25 damage to target enemy and increases the cost of their skills by 1 Random energy for 1 turn.

gallantmon5.name: Shield of the Just
gallantmon5.description: Deals 30 True damage to target enemy. If this skill is replacing Gallant Guard, Gallantmon becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. If this skill is replacing Lightning Joust, the enemy is also stunned for 1 turn.

omnimon1.name: Transcendent Sword
omnimon1.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. If that enemy is Omnimon's Nemesis, this skill will Bypass and remove all Shield effects from the target before damaging them.

omnimon2.name: Garuru Cannon
omnimon2.description: Deals 30 Piercing damage to target enemy. If that enemy is Omnimon's Nemesis, this skill will Bypass and stun their non-Strategic skills for 1 turn.

omnimon3.name: Destiny Digivolve
omnimon3.description: For the next 4 turns, Omnimon will ignore Harmful, non-damaging effects and if his Nemesis is alive, he can only target them. During this time, his Nemesis is Isolated.

omnimon5.name: Digidestiny
omnimon5.description: Passive: At the start of the game, Omnimon marks a random enemy as his Nemesis. If Omnimon kills his Nemesis, he will heal 25 HP, and his damaging skills permanently trigger their bonus effects.

nagisa1.name: Killing Intent
nagisa1.description: Deals 10 Affliction damage to one enemy for 2 turns. During this time, they are Silenced.

nagisa2.name: Bloody Knife
nagisa2.description: Deals 25 damage to one enemy. For 2 turns, any Killing Intent used will steal health and deal 5 more damage.

nagisa3.name: Don't Test Me
nagisa3.description: For one turn, Nagisa will ignore all Harmful effects and damage. Any character who uses a skill on them during this time will be Silenced for 2 turns.

nagisa4.name: Friendly Smile
nagisa4.description: Nagisa becomes Invulnerable for 1 turn. Increases the duration of Killing Intent by 1 turn until the next time it is used (stacks).

nagisa5.name: Natural Assassin
nagisa5.description: Passive: Nagisa permanently takes 5 less damage from Silenced characters.

koro1.name: Hard Lessons
koro1.description: For the next 4 turns, Koro-sensei will make all characters Invulnerable to one of the following classes of skills for 1 turn, chosen at random: Physical, Mental, Energy, Affliction. Each turn the chosen class will change to a random choice of the classes that haven't been chosen yet.

koro2.name: Impossible Speed
koro2.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If used during Hard Lessons, this skill will activate Class Is In Session on a random ally with a random instance of its normal effects.

koro3.name: Protective Molting
koro3.description: Koro-Sensei targets another ally for 1 turn. During this time, if they receive a new Harmful skill, they will have all enemy effects removed from them and heal 25 HP. The turn after this effect is triggered, Pitch Black has no cost.

koro4.name: Pitch Black
koro4.description: For the next 4 turns, Impossible Speed Bypasses and will mark its target for the remainder of Pitch Black's duration. During this time, whenever Impossible Speed is used, Koro-Sensei will also use it on any marked target.

koro5.name: Class Is In Session!
koro5.description: Passive: Whenever any other character ends their turn without using a new skill, they will gain 10 Shield for 1 turn. Whenever any other character is stunned, they will heal 10 HP.

mars1.name: Blazing Mandala
mars1.description: Targets a character marked by Ofuda. If they are an enemy, they receive 5 damage per character marked by Ofuda. If they are an ally, they are healed for 5 HP per character marked by Ofuda.

mars2.name: Akuryo Taisen
mars2.description: Targets a character marked by Ofuda. If they are an enemy, they receive 20 damage and are Stunned for 1 turn. If they are an ally, they are healed for 25 HP.

mars3.name: Snake Fire
mars3.description: Targets an enemy marked by Ofuda, dealing 15 affliction damage to them for 3 turns. During this time, any ally marked by Ofuda will heal 15 HP if they use a new Harmful skill on that enemy.

mars4.name: Ofuda
mars4.description: Mars marks one target and one random character for the rest of the game, allowing them to be targeted by her other abilities.
